_comment: Cells per scheduled run. weekly_reset is when the agent's weekly quota resets (local time, e.g. "mon 09:00"); For a monthly quota (Cursor) give monthly_reset (day of the month) instead. Within final_hours of the reset a run does final_cells so the quota left is not wasted. Put your own values in .subgen/schedule.json (same shape, not in Git).
